description: This file defines the SNProtectionService class which manages security protections such as session expiration, biometrics, passcodes, and related authentication challenges within the application. It includes enums, functions, and methods for handling protection sessions, biometric settings, and challenge prompts.

classes.name: SNProtectionService
classes.description: A service class that enforces extra authentication actions, manages protection sessions, biometrics, passcodes, and handles challenge prompts for protected actions.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up timers and references when the service is deinitialized.

methods.name: handleApplicationStage
methods.description: Handles application stage changes, updating session timers and biometrics settings.

methods.name: hasProtectionSources
methods.description: Checks if there are any protection sources (account, passcode, biometrics) enabled.

methods.name: hasUnprotectedAccessSession
methods.description: Determines if there is an active unprotected session based on expiry date.

methods.name: enableBiometrics
methods.description: Enables biometrics and stores the state.

methods.name: createLaunchChallenge
methods.description: Creates a challenge prompt for unlocking the app, including biometrics and passcode prompts.

methods.name: authorizeProtectedActionForItems
methods.description: Authorizes access to multiple items, renewing session if needed.

methods.name: authorizeItemAccess
methods.description: Authorizes access to a specific decrypted item.

methods.name: authorizeAction
methods.description: Performs a generic challenge-based authorization for an action.

methods.name: getMobilePasscodeTimingOptions
methods.description: Returns timing options for mobile passcode unlocking.

methods.name: getMobileBiometricsTimingOptions
methods.description: Returns timing options for mobile biometrics unlocking.

methods.name: setMobileScreenshotPrivacyEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables mobile screenshot privacy.

methods.name: validateOrRenewSession
methods.description: Validates current session or prompts for renewal via challenge.

methods.name: getSessionExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the current session expiry date.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears the current session and notifies expiration.

methods.name: setSessionLength
methods.description: Sets a new session length and updates expiry.

methods.name: updateSessionExpiryTimer
methods.description: Updates the timer for session expiry.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Returns diagnostic info about protection states.
